interpretation: Named corrected contracts and source refutations; metadata is not a semantic proof.

rows.statement: There is a forgetful functor U from the category of theories equipped with the modal, structural and propositional layers to the category of theories in classifying form, a left adjoint F freely adjoining those layers, and the induced endofunctor K = U after F is a monad: for each theory T, K(T) is the underlying theory of its free extension by generated type formers.
rows.construction: GSLT/Core/RelativeClosedBareLogicalAdjunction.lean: freeObject, freeMap and free generate named native predicates, positioned-rule modalities and structural constructor images, with finite conjunction, implication and both quantifiers at every generated arrow. The source is independently supplied closed program/reduction theories; maps are taken modulo compatible whole-context isomorphisms. This is the explicit connective profile of the free-extension statement, not an unqualified extension by every possible logical capability
rows.provedTheorem: GSLT/Core/RelativeClosedBareLogicalAdjunction.lean: homEquiv, homEquiv_natural_left_symm, homEquiv_natural_right and adjunction earn the natural hom correspondence and actual Mathlib free/forgetful adjunction, with left_triangle and right_triangle. RelativeClosedBareLogicalMonad.lean: Construction.monad is the induced monad; right_unit, left_unit and associativity give its laws. complete_program_readout, complete_event_readout, folds_universal, folds_existential and folds_complete_implication retain the full operations under multiplication
rows.instanceWitness: GSLT/Core/RelativeClosedBareLogicalControls.lean: actual_zero_pair_source, actual_zero_pair_reduct, complete_selected_firing and entire_constructor_function recover an independently renamed successor rewrite, its authored firing and complete constructor functions; actual_quantifier_created_arrow_folds checks both quantifiers over an arrow generated by the first extension
rows.negativeControl: GSLT/Core/RelativeClosedBareLogicalControls.lean: incorrect_unrenamed_reduct_rejected prevents omission of the program comparison. RelativeClosedConjunctiveAdjunctionControls.lean: actual_monad_is_not_the_identity_up_to_natural_isomorphism separates the free conjunctive extension from an identity construction. Framework/TypeFormerExtension.lean: rhoTwice_rejected remains a counterexample to obtaining this monad from unchecked declaration growth alone

rows.citation: Section 19.3, authored rewrite and redex generation
rows.statement: Generate each authored rewrite at every one-hole redex position, retaining the focus, rely variables, matched variables and declaration origin. Every independently typed occurrence has a finite checked annotation; executable schemas additionally require the original declaration's operational admission.
rows.construction: Framework/Chapter19Sites.lean: generate and decompositions enumerate raw syntax, including binders, substitution nodes and collection tails. Chapter19SchemaSites.lean supplies the separate typed schematic derivative. Chapter19Generator.lean compiles the actual selected declarations. Chapter19GeneratedAnnotatedSources.lean checks complete source and descent annotations, including arbitrary arrow and substitution types, before Chapter19GeneratedAnnotatedSchemas.lean finds the actual operational declaration.
rows.provedTheorem: Chapter19Sites.generate_spec, generated_source_reconstructed, generated_focus_readback, rely_names_spec and hidden_names_spec; Chapter19SchemaSites.generate_spec and Chapter19ModalCatalogueCoverage.schemas_program_typedAt_complete. The latter covers independently TypedAt occurrences at every declared program carrier for computationally classifying, substitution-free sources; it derives carrier-list membership and context permission. The broader checked route is Chapter19ModalAnnotations.annotation_exists_iff, descent_annotation_exists_iff and Chapter19Generator.every_generated_typed_site_has_annotation: every independently TypedAt occurrence is checkable, without a finite carrier restriction. annotated_source_engine_complete derives schema admission from actual plan membership.
rows.instanceWitness: Chapter19RhoSchemaConsumer.original_rest_source_is_typed, computed_typed_continuation_preserves_tail and same_generator_types_and_executes_comm retain the unchanged REST-bearing COMM. Chapter19LambdaConsumer covers independently licensed binder occurrences.
rows.negativeControl: Chapter19ModalSourceCarrierControls exposes genuinely typed arrow roots outside automatic carrier inference. Explicit annotations address that inference boundary; missing operational declarations still return unresolvedOperationalDeclaration, rather than a certified empty schema catalogue.

rows.statement: For a rewrite rule and an admissible redex position, form the modality from typed rely codes and an assignment-indexed continuation at the computed output sort, before requiring any inhabitant.
rows.construction: Framework/Chapter19GeneratedModalCodes.lean: Generated.modalFormer? consumes the actual catalogue, original declaration and computed slot parameters. Chapter19SourceCenterModalCodes.lean retains classified rely-code syntax and the complete continuation family. Generated.annotatedModalFormer? uses the same computed slots and gates for computationally checked annotated schemas.
rows.provedTheorem: Chapter19Generator.generated_m_form and generated_modal_same_output_sort form every catalogue member under accepted equation admission and typed input codes. Chapter19SourceCenter carrier_read_exact, kind_read_exact and universes_disjoint provide independent carrier/universe judgments; generated_equation_modal_formation_complete returns syntax-bearing outputs, and equation_modal_code_native_comparison compares them with the actual semantic former. annotated_modal_formation_complete and annotated_modal_result_slot and generated_annotated_m_form cover every checked annotation instance, with computed coordinate completeness. Chapter19SortRelativeGeneratedCodes interprets formed outputs in the chosen program-sort subobject. Joint E/R compilation is a separate stronger contract.
rows.instanceWitness: Chapter19RhoPaperConsumer.computed_continuation_schema and Chapter19RhoSchemaConsumer.continuation_parameters_are_computed recover the actual continuation carrier and input coordinates from generated catalogues.
rows.negativeControl: Chapter19Generator.generated_schema_rejected refuses a missing or different schema fingerprint; Chapter19SourceCenter.wrong_universe_is_refused separates well-carried expressions from malformed universe formation.

rows.statement: The generated introduction law types the authored focus when every admitted rely instance has the specified reduct in the continuation after substitution. Conditional rules retain their actual premise witnesses.
rows.construction: Framework/Chapter19ModalSourceIntroduction.lean computes scoped matcher answers and base introductions. Chapter19ModalRules.lean constructs the actual primitive firing receipt and the dependent response family.
rows.provedTheorem: Chapter19ModalSourceIntroduction.baseIntroductions_spec and m_intro_computed, together with Chapter19ModalRules.m_intro. The introduction premises are independently specified matching, scoped assignments, ordered premise derivations, source/target typing and continuation witnesses; no assumed modal inhabitant or supplied step oracle occurs. Chapter19SortRelativeNativeIntroduction.introduce computes the same construction inside the chosen sort model, using independently stated constructor closure and primitive equation interpretation; equation_sort_transport derives conversion closure.
rows.instanceWitness: Chapter19ModalSourceProfile.all_proper_bodies_execute and all_proper_bodies_inhabit hold for every independently admitted function body and ambient context; Chapter19RhoPaperBinding checks actual continuation substitution. Chapter19SortRelativeLambdaControls discharges the model conditions for disjoint proper variable and compound-term domains, with actual lambda reduction.
rows.negativeControl: Chapter19ModalConditionalControls proves that a typed reduct alone cannot discharge a missing relation-query premise. Chapter19ModalHiddenAssignments.no_rely_only_contractum shows why matched variables must remain in the continuation assignment.

rows.statement: For every inhabitant of the generated modality, filling its context with rely values steps to the specified authored right-hand-side instance.
rows.construction: The literal rule is incompatible with the existential-successor interpretation in Stay and Wells Section 7. Framework/Chapter19ModalRules.lean supplies the corrected specified-contractum interpretation, retaining matched variables, equation conversions and an actual firing receipt.
rows.provedTheorem: Chapter19ModalCounterexamples.literal_m_step_refuted and existential_comparison_is_strict kernel-refute the literal existential interpretation. The corrected law is Chapter19ModalRules.m_step; Chapter19ModalNativeElimination.elimination_contract retains the exact authored RHS and all conversions, not an arbitrary successor.
rows.instanceWitness: Chapter19ModalCounterexamples uses Alpha = Beta, Beta -> Done and Other -> Alpha with an equation-invariant continuation. Other inhabits the existential modality but cannot step to Done. Chapter19RhoPaperBinding supplies a binder-dependent authored RHS consumer.
rows.negativeControl: Chapter19ModalCounterexamples.corrected_modality_rejects_other; Chapter19ModalContextControls shows that focus conversion cannot be lifted through an unlicensed context.

rows.statement: The specified authored right-hand-side instance inhabits the continuation after the rely substitution.
rows.construction: The existential-successor meaning does not imply membership of the specified RHS. The corrected dependent modality retains the complete matched/rely assignment and a continuation certificate at that exact RHS.
rows.provedTheorem: Chapter19ModalCounterexamples.literal_m_elim_refuted kernel-refutes the literal existential interpretation. Chapter19ModalRules.m_elim proves the specified-contractum correction; Chapter19ModalNativeElimination.elimination_contract and direct_elimination_agrees compare its native witness and readout. Chapter19ModalPossibility.possibility_iff_existential_step supplies the separate empty-context possibility law under equation-invariant support.
rows.instanceWitness: Chapter19ModalSourceProfile.all_proper_bodies_inhabit and the rho authored substitution consumer retain actual certificates, rather than only target support.
rows.negativeControl: Chapter19ModalHiddenAssignments proves that equal rely values do not determine a contractum when matched variables differ; elimination_preserves_origins retains receipt origins.

rows.statement: Each constructor freely induces a structural former whose inhabitants are exactly terms with that representative root; binary constructors induce positional or associative-commutative splits, and connectives are supplied at the selected logical strength.
rows.construction: The representative-root assertion is false modulo root-changing equations. The correction classifies the typed constructor image up to the authored equation relation. Framework/Chapter19StructuralFormers.lean, Chapter19StructuralSemantics.lean and Chapter19StructuralLogic.lean implement that interpretation; actual declarations generate the formers.
rows.provedTheorem: Chapter19StructuralLogic.Controls.authored_equation_changes_representative_root refutes the literal root assertion. The correction is structural_former_exact and structural_equation_invariant; structural_free_root recovers the free case. authored_ac_split_commutative and authored_ac_split_associative derive the split laws from detected authored equations; Chapter19SourceCenter.constructor_meaning_exact compares actual recursive native code syntax with the generated structural former. Chapter19PropositionalCodes.checkFormation_exact computes independent carrier/universe formation. Chapter19SortRelativePropositionalCodes.readout_exact, top_exact, complement_exact and generated_readout_transport interpret and transport generated operations inside the chosen actual sort subobject.
rows.instanceWitness: Chapter19StructuralLogic.Controls.binder_root_executes and detected_ac_separating_laws; Chapter19StructuralRhoSpatial exercises rho bare-bag structure through actual declarations. Chapter19StructuralDecompositionControls executes free and rho splits through the generated checker. Chapter19PropositionalCodeControls separates actual program-sort complements from carrier-wide complements.
rows.negativeControl: free_split_is_positional rejects the reversed free split; absent_ac_law_is_not_detected does not infer commutativity from a unit equation; binder_representation_rejected rejects a wrongly represented abstraction.

rows.citation: Section 19.6, sort slots and the equational center
rows.statement: Each modal former has one slot per rely input and one output slot. Equations and rewrite laws restrict the generated cube to stable assignments in the chosen sort interpretation. The precise local interpretation here is partial typed formation; full operation-table models have a separate center and are not identified with local profiles.
rows.construction: Framework/Chapter19SortSlots.lean computes local coordinates from generated sites. Chapter19EquationalCenter.lean computes full finite operation-table models. Chapter19CoherenceStableSource.lean checks formation-preserving local profiles against original authored laws. Chapter19GeneratorCertifiedCenter.lean enumerates the actual generator's joint equation/rewrite center and retains accepted, rejected and unresolved vertices. Its independent source contract makes support conditions structural and checks every typed formation judgment. Chapter19GeneratorGuardedCenter additionally reads actual finite nullary-query guards; Chapter19GeneratorBindingCenter checks original binding laws in finite complete-function models with source-derived carrier candidates.
rows.provedTheorem: Chapter19GeneratorCertifiedCenter.mem_center_iff and selected_source_stability_original prove exact computed membership against the original selected declarations. center_intersection separates equation and directed stability; center_rename proves source-variable renaming invariance, and partial_operation_graph specifies the local slots' actual partial interpretation. Chapter19GeneratorCertifiedCenter.member_modal_equation_universe and member_modal_directed_universe preserve every computed rely and substituted-continuation coordinate under the selected code-law relations, without asserting semantic-set equality. Chapter19EquationalCenter.mem_center_iff separately proves the full-table contract. Chapter19SourceCenter generated_native_equation_universe and generated_native_directed_universe require jointAdmission = some true and transfer laws to constructor-code universe judgments. They do not by themselves supply a chosen native Pattern model. Renaming invariance is stable_profile_center_rename. Chapter19GeneratorBindingCenter.check_law_exact and generated_binding_equations_exact compare executable checks to independent intrinsic binding valuations, keeping this model center distinct from kind formation. Chapter19BindingCenterStability.accepted_equation_descendants derives full contextual binding-equation congruence from complete-function satisfaction; Chapter19Generator.generated_binding_consequences_sound joins actual selected law streams.
rows.instanceWitness: Chapter19GeneratorCertifiedCenterControls.proper_nonempty_actual_generated_center derives a proper joint center from actual authored equation and rewrite streams. nonidentity_code_law_preserves_generated_universe checks an actual code-law instance. Chapter19SourceCenter has disjoint code universes and syntax-bearing semantic outputs. Chapter19GeneratorBindingControls checks the entire original scoped equation stream and refutes an incorrect binder law at every vertex.
rows.negativeControl: guarded_vertex_retained_as_unresolved and guarded_vertex_is_not_refuted preserve unresolved uniform laws. lawful_source_table_is_not_a_constant_output_profile distinguishes interpretations rather than refuting the source paragraph. no_equations_accepts_equation_check_but_rejects_joint_check separates E-only admission from R preservation. The guarded route admits finite nullary-query guards, while Chapter19CenterGuardDescent shows that general argument-query truth cannot be inferred from the sort readout. Non-finite binding carriers and unsupported premise forms remain unresolved; these boundaries do not refute a richer arbitrary-language construction.

rows.citation: Section 19.7, rho continuation cube and channel face
rows.statement: The no-tail arity-one COMM continuation has two rely inputs and one output, seven nonempty lifting directions, and the four-corner Barendregt square at the fixed channel slot.

rows.statement: Generating a type system alone does not establish adequacy for its operational observations.
rows.construction: Framework/Chapter19SourceBoundaries.lean interprets all independently formed formulas of a selected conjunctive fragment, beside the independently generated GSLT steps.
rows.provedTheorem: Chapter19SourceBoundaries.generated_fragment_need_not_be_adequate: every formed question of that fragment agrees at two actual typed states, while one state has an outgoing step and the other has none.
rows.instanceWitness: The Alpha/Beta/Other/Done language has a real equation and actual generated execution. The theorem quantifies over independent formula formation, not a hand-written question list.
rows.negativeControl: Chapter19ObservationControls supplies a separately indexed instrument extension that distinguishes shapes; adequacy is not silently transferred from that richer observation index.

rows.statement: Adequacy is relative to a chosen observation index.
rows.construction: Framework/Chapter19ObservationControls.lean compares the actual generated reduction system, structural questions and the authored ask/get instrument extension.
rows.provedTheorem: Chapter19ObservationControls.Instrument.observer_index_strictly_changes_equivalence and negation_free_generated_adequacy: bare reductions equate two inert constructors, while admitted structural questions and instrument steps separate them. The instrument adequacy proof uses the independently defined extended relation.
rows.instanceWitness: Both structural questions execute through the actual generated checker; an actual ask step witnesses the changed observation index.
rows.negativeControl: The checked bare-reduction bisimulation cannot be reused as an instrument bisimulation. The formula readout theorem ranges over the complete formed fragment.

rows.statement: An interaction cut privileges a family of positions; the generator is obtained by considering every position rather than privileging a family.
rows.construction: Framework/Chapter19Sites.lean derives one-hole decompositions from syntax. Typed schematic positions and the operational site-permission policy remain separate constructions.
rows.provedTheorem: Chapter19Sites.generate_spec and Chapter19SchemaSites.generate_spec; Chapter19ModalCatalogueCoverage.schemas_program_typedAt_complete. The raw theorem covers every authored occurrence. The typed theorem states and derives the precise classifying-program admission and preserves binder contexts and collection tails. Chapter19Generator.every_generated_typed_site_has_annotation covers the broader checked instance family, including explicit substitutions and arbitrary arrows.

rows.negativeControl: Chapter19ModalContextControls exhibits a raw surrounding context whose operational permissions do not license conversion; raw occurrence generation is not an assertion that every context is a reduction context.

rows.statement: The specification supplies the categorical/connective fragment; finite limits give a conjunctive fragment, and refusal to elaborate an unavailable connective is distinct from falsehood.
rows.construction: Framework/Chapter19StructuralLogic.lean takes a chosen connective-strength fragment and independently specifies formula formation. Chapter19Generator.lean consumes that fragment. This does not infer categorical strength merely from an enum or from raw LanguageDef syntax.
rows.provedTheorem: Chapter19StructuralLogic.elaborate_success_iff and unsupported_connective_refused; Chapter19Generator.Controls.connective_refusal_is_not_false. Accepted formulas have the supplied fragment's independent formation derivation. Chapter19GeneratedReadoutSound proves the actual positive and negative semantic readouts. Sort-relative interpretation is separate from code-kind classification and assumes a chosen carrier-bounded classifying model.

Chapter19PropositionalCodeControls.actual_star_top_readout and actual_box_top_readout exercise distinct nonempty sort subobjects; bottom_forms_but_is_uninhabited keeps formation refusal separate from falsehood.

rows.statement: Without built-in equations the E-center is the whole raw cube; the lambda example does not require an equational restriction.

These are general empty-equation theorems, not lambda ground checks.

rows.citation: Section 19.9, independent dials and budgeted checking
rows.statement: Language fragment, connective fragment and cube vertex independently control one generator; a checking budget prevents runaway search without turning exhaustion into falsehood.
rows.construction: Framework/Chapter19Generator.lean implements generate with the three inputs, actual operational compilation and generated catalogues. Chapter19GeneratorChecking.lean calls the certified frontier engine; the structural/propositional readouts retain its state. Chapter19GeneratedModalChecking.lean checks specified-contractum instances with actual source execution and target conversion paths. Chapter19GeneratedAnnotatedChecking.lean extends that same engine route to computationally checked annotations.
rows.provedTheorem: Chapter19Generator.Controls language_selection_changes_the_actual_signature, language_rule_selection_changes_the_actual_executor, changing_connectives_preserves_execution_input and cube_changes_actual_produced_code_sorts. Chapter19GeneratorBudgetControls.funded_target_persists, resumed_query_preserves_actual_state, unknown_does_not_certify_absence and every_sorted_object_has_complete_generated_execution derive the budget/completeness laws from actual paths and finite coverage. Universal rely membership is not inferred from one checked assignment. Chapter19Generator.generated_annotated_instance_positive_sound, generated_annotated_instance_negative_sound and generated_annotated_response_native_origin extend the actual engine and retained receipt laws to checked annotation instances.
rows.instanceWitness: The same generator runs rho COMM, nested lambda beta reduction and the authored proper-center theory. Budget controls pause before discovering an actual firing and resume to its retained receipt.
rows.negativeControl: The zero-budget empty state is unknown despite a proved outgoing step. Disabling rules changes execution, changing connective strength changes elaboration, and changing a cube vertex changes actual code sorts.

rows.statement: Adequacy requires negation; choosing a finitely checkable fragment generally leaves the adequate region.
rows.construction: The universal necessity claim is false. Framework/Chapter19ObservationControls.lean supplies a nontrivial finite instrument language with adequate negation-free generated questions and checked finite readouts. The source's typical trade-off remains a qualified observation, not an unconditional impossibility theorem.
rows.provedTheorem: Chapter19ObservationControls.Instrument.universal_negation_necessity_refuted, negation_free_generated_adequacy and generated_check_conclusive. Chapter19SourceBoundaries.generated_fragment_need_not_be_adequate separately shows that a weaker chosen fragment can lose operational distinctions.
rows.instanceWitness: The finite example has two actual constructors, genuine ask/get observations and independently formed formulas. Its complete finite checker is proved over every closed term of the language.
rows.negativeControl: Bare reductions alone do not distinguish the constructors; instrument extension does. This prevents changing the observation index silently when claiming adequacy.
